title: Assistance for Area Expansion of Vegetable Crops through Hybrid Seed

scheme.name: Assistance for Area Expansion of Vegetable Crops through Hybrid Seed
scheme.summary: The scheme aims to support vegetable farmers in enhancing their cultivation areas using hybrid seeds and to promote natural farming practices, helping reduce input costs and encouraging sustainable agricultural methods.
eligibility: The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.
The applicant should be a farmer.
The applicant should be engaged in vegetable crop cultivation.
scheme.benefits: Subsidy assistance for area expansion using hybrid seeds (40% of unit cost or up to ₹20,000/- per hectare, whichever is less) and promotion of natural farming in vegetable crops (maximum assistance ₹20,000/- per hectare).
scheme.how_to_apply: Apply online at the I-Khedut Portal by registering as a beneficiary, selecting the scheme under Agricultural Schemes, filling out the application, confirming it, and taking a printout.

summary.value: The scheme aims to support vegetable farmers in enhancing their cultivation areas using hybrid seeds and to promote natural farming practices, helping reduce input costs and encouraging sustainable agricultural methods.
summary.quote: The scheme "Assistance for Area Expansion of Vegetable Crops through Hybrid Seed" by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to support vegetable farmers in enhancing their cultivation areas using hybrid seeds and to promote natural farming practices. The financial assistance provided under the scheme helps reduce input costs and encourages environmentally sustainable agricultural methods among the farming community.
